scenario: [LSMP.3.1] admits over the reservoir bag `mean`, `median`, `pXX`, `variance`, `pvariance`, `stdev`, `pstdev`, `min`, `max`, `sum`, `count`. `compiler/LSER.sample_ok` compiles mean, stdev, p95, min, max, sum and count; this compiles the four it leaves out -- `median`, `variance`, `pvariance`, `pstdev` -- on one `sample 200` line, with no accuracy phrase, and a rule reading the `median` companion. A compiler that refused any of the four, or demanded a tolerance under `sample`, fails it.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

series Sensor.state:
    median, variance, pvariance, pstdev sample 200

rule r:
    Sensor s where s.median > 50.0
->
    log info "{s.entity_id}"
